steps.what: Record nursing care fields the form already names.
Identify, collect, and analyze data relevant to nursing care of patients.
Check the record against the source note before filing.

tasks.design: Nursing care fields the form already names are recorded in {DATA_PLATFORM}. The specialist identifies, collects, and analyzes the data that are relevant to the patient. A field with no form id is not recorded. The form does not analyze the care.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same nursing facts were written twice, once on the form and once in a note that did not match.
tasks.enabler_now: A field the form already names can be recorded before the specialist collects what the form cannot hold.
tasks.still_hard: A fact the patient will not give, and a form field that does not match the care.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist can tell that a complete form still misses the thing that matters for this patient.
tasks.altitude: Named fields can be recorded. The specialist still identifies what is relevant, still collects it, and still analyzes it.

reach.task: Take a field the form already names, and still leave the collection with the patient here.
reach.learn: The field can be recorded. The analysis stays here.

evidence.claim: A nursing care field the form already names can be recorded. The form cannot identify which data are relevant or analyze the care.
The specialist collects data the patient provides and checks it against the source note. The form does not decide the care.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A health informatics specialist in a mid-size European care organisation. A list does not interpret a patient, write a privacy rule, or enter a home.

Fields: Form id and field id, produced by the form the service already uses. A field the form does not name is not recorded by the first step. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the informatics specialist finishes it by hand.
Native check: Record only fields the specialist is already allowed to store. Do not infer a diagnosis from an empty field.
unknowns: Which fields the current form names.
Which patients must be asked in person.
research_questions: What share of records are fields the form already names?
Which relevant facts never have a field?

already_counted.description: The specialist still collects and analyzes the care data.
The specialist still checks the record.

incremental.description: The specialist writes a fact the form had no field for.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is recording nursing care fields the form already names. It disappears when the fact has no field and the specialist writes it. Identifying, collecting, and analyzing the care stays with the specialist.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List informatics theory notes already filed for the topic.
Apply nursing and information science in collaboration with other specialists.
Record the education or research point the group accepted.

tasks.design: Informatics theory notes already filed for the topic are listed from {DOCS}. The specialist applies nursing and information science with the other specialists, including education, administration, and research. A note with no topic id is not listed. The list does not hold the collaboration.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same theory paper was searched for again before every working session.
tasks.enabler_now: A theory note already filed for the topic can be listed before the specialists meet.
tasks.still_hard: A collaboration where the filed note is the wrong theory for this practice.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist can tell that the group is applying a theory the note does not contain.
tasks.altitude: Filed theory notes can be listed. The specialist still applies them with the other specialists and still records what the group accepted.

reach.task: Bring a filed note to the working session, and still do the collaboration in the room.
reach.learn: The note can be listed. The collaboration stays here.

evidence.claim: A theory note already filed for a topic can be listed. The list cannot apply nursing or information science, and it cannot replace the collaboration.
The specialist works with the other specialists in person or on a call. A reading list does not make the decision the group is there to make.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A health informatics specialist in a mid-size European care organisation. A list does not interpret a patient, write a privacy rule, or enter a home.

Fields: Topic id and note id, produced by the library the specialists already file into. A note with no topic id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the informatics specialist finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the library the group already shares. Do not score which specialist spoke.
unknowns: Which topics already have a filed note.
Which sessions must be held with the other specialists present.
research_questions: What share of sessions start from a filed note?
Which collaborations have no filed theory behind them?

already_counted.description: The specialist still applies the science with the others.
The specialist still records the accepted point.

incremental.description: The specialist files a theory note the library did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing theory notes already filed for the topic. It disappears when the note is missing and the specialist finds it. Applying the science with the other specialists stays in the room.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List stored data management tools the nurses already use.
Evaluate the health information technology process that will assist nurses.
Record whether to develop, implement, or modify the application.

tasks.design: Data management tools the nurses already use are listed from {DOCS}. The specialist develops, implements, or evaluates the health information technology process that assists them. A tool with no id is not listed. The list does not evaluate the process.
tasks.previous_blocker: Tool names were collected by asking each ward, and the same tool appeared under two names.
tasks.enabler_now: A tool the nurses already use, with a stored id, can be listed before the evaluation.
tasks.still_hard: A process that looks complete on the list and still does not assist the nurse.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist can watch a nurse fail a step the tool list calls finished.
tasks.altitude: Known tools can be listed. The specialist still evaluates the process and still decides whether to develop, implement, or modify it.

reach.role: Software Quality Assurance Analysts and Testers
reach.task: Take a named tool the nurses already use, and still leave the evaluation of the process here.
reach.learn: The tool id can be shared. The evaluation stays here.

evidence.claim: A data management tool the nurses already use can be listed when it has an id. The list cannot evaluate whether the process assists them.
The specialist decides whether to develop, implement, or modify the application. The list does not put a tool into use.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A health informatics specialist in a mid-size European care organisation. A list does not interpret a patient, write a privacy rule, or enter a home.

Fields: Tool id, produced by the register of tools nurses already use. A tool with no id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the informatics specialist finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the tool register the wards already keep. Do not switch a tool on from the list.
unknowns: Which tools already have an id.
Who may implement a change on a ward.
research_questions: What share of evaluations start from a stored tool id?
Which processes assist nurses and have no tool id?

already_counted.description: The specialist still evaluates the process.
The specialist still records the decision.

incremental.description: The specialist documents a tool the register did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing data management tools the nurses already use. It disappears when the tool has no id and the specialist documents it. Evaluating the process stays with the specialist.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List stored requirements for the informatics solution under test.
Design and evaluate the decision support mechanism for patients.
Select the version health professionals will test with patients.

tasks.design: Requirements already stored for the solution under test are listed from {DOCS}. The specialist designs, selects, tests, and evaluates the decision support mechanism. It does not propose a diagnosis or a dose. A requirement with no solution id is not listed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Requirements for a support screen were restated in each meeting, and a draft once suggested a dose nobody had approved.
tasks.enabler_now: A requirement already stored for the solution can be listed before the specialist designs.
tasks.still_hard: A mechanism that would recommend a treatment, which this job does not switch on.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist can reject a screen that looks complete and would still tell a clinician what to do.
tasks.altitude: Stored requirements can be listed. The specialist still designs and evaluates the mechanism, and a clinician tests it. No screen proposes a diagnosis or a dose.

reach.task: Build only the version a clinician will test, and do not let the screen recommend a treatment.
reach.learn: The requirement list can be shared. The selection stays here.

evidence.claim: A requirement already stored for a solution under test can be listed. The list cannot design a decision support mechanism.
A screen that proposes a diagnosis or a dose is not switched on here. A health professional tests any support the specialist designs, with the patient relationship unchanged.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A health informatics specialist in a mid-size European care organisation. A list does not interpret a patient, write a privacy rule, or enter a home.

Fields: Solution id and requirement id, produced by the test register. A requirement with no solution id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the informatics specialist finishes it by hand.
Native check: Do not enable a recommendation of a diagnosis or a dose. The specialist selects the version a professional will test.
unknowns: Which solutions already have stored requirements.
Which professionals are allowed to test with patients.
research_questions: What share of designs start from a stored requirement?
Which mechanisms were stopped because they would recommend a treatment?

already_counted.description: The specialist still designs and evaluates the mechanism.
The specialist still selects the version to test.

incremental.description: The specialist writes a requirement the register did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing requirements already stored for the solution under test. It disappears when the requirement is missing and the specialist writes it. Designing the mechanism, and keeping it from proposing a dose, stays with the specialist.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The specialist still collects nursing data, still works with the other specialists, and still evaluates a tool. A named field or a stored requirement can be listed first. No screen proposes a diagnosis or a dose.
reach: Database administrators keep a field definition with the person who owns it, and this job learns a form does not analyze the care.
Software developers leave a decision support mechanism unswitched until a clinician has tested it, and this job learns the same limit.
skills_to_grow: Collect nursing data with the patient, and do not treat a form as the analysis.
Leave any decision support unswitched until a clinician has tested it.
role.ambitious_version: Named fields and stored requirements are listed first, and collecting the data, judging the tool, and any support for a clinician stay with the specialist.
